title: Exercism Python exercise: poker
prompt:
# Instructions

Pick the best hand(s) from a list of poker hands.

See [Wikipedia][poker-hands] for an overview of poker hands.

[poker-hands]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_poker_hands

####

Use the above instructions to modify the supplied file: poker.py
Don't change the names of existing functions or classes, as they may be called by hidden tests.
Only use the Python standard library. The tests are in poker_test.py; you can run them with: python -m pytest -q poker_test.py
Do not edit the test file.
